concepts: Benefit-cost and multi-criteria analysis; housing needs; hazard maps; climate/demographic projections; vulnerability
proposed_evidence: Combine hazard, population, housing and cost evidence; store normative multi-criteria weights separately.
model_implication: No single public file provides a decision-support score; derive outputs and retain assumptions.

concepts: Government, homeowners, leased-land owners, renters, commercial users, NGOs, Indigenous interests
proposed_evidence: Link tenure, ownership, parcel use and program eligibility; verify leasehold and community/tribal interests.
model_implication: Split resident households from owning entities and overlapping social groups.

concepts: Ancestral land, place, language, nonmarket values, communal tenure, land return, historic forced relocation
proposed_evidence: Use consultation routing, relevant histories, title records and community-defined evidence.
model_implication: Localize the generic Canadian framing; do not infer numerical attachment/trauma effects from identity.

concepts: New industry, replacement housing, local rehousing, redevelopment, livelihoods
proposed_evidence: Follow taxable rolls and jurisdiction retention; use jobs and housing-growth evidence for livelihood context.
model_implication: Add local rehousing and employment outcomes if required; forecast growth is not observed retention.

concepts: Parcel/community buyouts, leasebacks, easements, buffers, other acquisition, infrastructure realignment
proposed_evidence: Code program instruments, recorded restrictions, acquisition footprints and infrastructure work orders.
model_implication: The current property-buyout flows do not fully represent easements, leasebacks or network realignment.

concepts: Caseworkers, housing search, temporary housing, real-estate hazard advice, relocation and livelihood support
proposed_evidence: Request service delivery, staffed FTE, referrals and follow-up outcomes by household.
model_implication: Separate service availability, receipt and adequacy; add livelihood measures if included.

concepts: Authority, litigation, title, acquisition, rezoning, redevelopment and compliance
proposed_evidence: Use program rules, case-stage reasons, deed restrictions and permit records; code dated constraints.
model_implication: Case-record access remains unverified; legal complexity is a measured process feature, not a universal multiplier.

concepts: Lower exposure, housing quality, social ties, tax base and ecosystem condition
proposed_evidence: Build separate physical, housing, social, fiscal and ecological outcome indicators.
model_implication: Prespecify success and time horizon; no common index is implied by these distinct goals.

concepts: Demolition, decontamination, planting, restoration, recreation, commemoration, maintenance and ownership transfer
proposed_evidence: Request parcel treatment histories, accepted work, costs, restrictions and maintenance monitoring.
model_implication: Acquisition area is not restored area; decontamination and ongoing maintenance need their own costs.

concepts: Compensation, historical treatment, vulnerability, tenure, service access, heritage and intergenerational effects
proposed_evidence: Measure access, adequacy, waiting and outcomes by relevant groups; include historical context and future cohorts.
model_implication: Avoid overlapping household sums and equal-dollar fairness formulas; intergenerational weights are normative.

concepts: Preplanning, near-term implementation, long-term adaptation and post-retreat follow-up
proposed_evidence: Observe separate policy, application, move, demolition and ecological timelines; choose scenario horizon explicitly.
model_implication: Guide 1–100-year examples are not calibrated delay distributions.

concepts: Visualization, mapping, transparency, updates and community involvement
proposed_evidence: Code outreach formats and reach, resident comprehension, perceived voice and trust over repeated contacts.
model_implication: No meeting-count proxy establishes engagement quality or causal trust effects.

concepts: Psychosocial support, caseworkers, childcare, transport, liaisons and technical help
proposed_evidence: Record supports offered/received, costs, accessibility and who was excluded.
model_implication: These services should remain separately observable even if aggregated for model capacity.

concepts: Individuals, households, communities, critical infrastructure, protective works and industrial assets
proposed_evidence: Identify asset/occupancy classes and network retirement work, with distinct counts and units.
model_implication: Current residential inputs do not cover critical infrastructure or industrial relocation without extension.

concepts: House, street, neighborhood, community, subwatershed and watershed
proposed_evidence: Build spatial crosswalks among administrative, residential and hydrologic units.
model_implication: Nested totals must not be added; evaluate destination outside the model boundary.

concepts: Voluntary, incentives, persuasion, opt-out and mandatory approaches
proposed_evidence: Code documented acquisition-consent/authority rules and actual case pathways.
model_implication: Do not pool voluntary HCFCD and involuntary HCD outcomes without program/cohort controls.

concepts: Market, tax, pre/post-disaster value, bonuses and in-kind support
proposed_evidence: Track valuation date/basis and paid assistance components for each tenure and household type.
model_implication: Separate property purchase from relocation assistance; measure need-adjusted adequacy.

concepts: Insurance, local/state/federal, multiple funders, lenders and international sources
proposed_evidence: Build a source-of-funds ledger with awards, transfers, receipts and expenditure accounts.
model_implication: International and lender funding are optional scenarios until an actual relevant program is identified.

concepts: Adaptive, participatory, top-down, multisector, phased, public-private and interjurisdiction planning
proposed_evidence: Code governance structure, milestones and actual decision influence; specify adaptive policy rules.
model_implication: Method labels alone do not supply parameters; authority, timing and budgets must be explicit.

concepts: Funders, receiving communities, champions, governments, consultants, Indigenous groups, NGOs and academics
proposed_evidence: Create a dated actor register with responsibilities, participation and handoffs.
model_implication: Potential-actor denominator is a design decision; organizations and households need distinct counting rules.

concepts: Community-preferred terms, resilience, opportunity and other framing choices
proposed_evidence: Code actual materials and test understanding/acceptability through appropriately designed resident research.
model_implication: The mind map includes this mechanism but the guide lacks an explicit framing variable; do not assume an effect size.

concepts: Disaster, rebuilding costs, policy windows, community requests and proactive forecasts/vision
proposed_evidence: Link dated events, policy/funding actions and documented community requests to program operations.
model_implication: Separate historical triggers from hypothetical activation thresholds.

concepts: Flood, multiple hazards, climate drivers and compounding events
proposed_evidence: Define physical mechanisms, exposures and joint-event dependence before aggregation.
model_implication: The extension requires more than summing hazard indices or adding a fixed compounding multiplier.

concepts: Owners, communities, government, hazard specialists and finance experts
proposed_evidence: Code formal authority, actual influence, appeals and community-defined participation.
model_implication: Planning participation and final acquisition decisions are separate constructs.
